text: Being here, I feel curiosity blooming within me. The clean glass and technological displays evoke a sense of modern wonder, as if I'm standing on the threshold of human progress and creativity. It is a space that invites contemplation about innovation, knowledge, and our ever-advancing relationship with the world and each other. Yet, against this backdrop of calculated design, I am reminded that progress, like curiosity, is always unfinished—a journey rather than a destination.
